steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A sacrament is an outward sign of an inward grace — a visible ceremony that Christians believe channels God's grace (favour) to the believer. Most Christians recognise two sacraments (Baptism and Eucharist) but Catholics and Orthodox recognise seven. | Exam Tip: The Eucharist is the most important act of worship for Catholics — they believe they receive Christ himself. For Protestants, it is a memorial that strengthens faith and unity. Be ready to explain both views with specific theological terms. | RS Exam Tips — Sacraments: Baptism and Eucharist: 1.
